other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Himachal Pradesh
Must have worked in building or construction activities for at least 90 days in the preceding 12 months
Worker must have continuous membership with the Welfare Board for three years before attaining age 60
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of at least ₹1,000 for eligible workers aged 60 and above.
documents_required: Wage slip or appointment letter from employer
Certificate from local authority (e.g., councilor, executive officer, Panchayat Secretary)
